title: ESP, Aimbot, Triggerbot & Silent Aim | Bot Detector
features:
ESP and aim tools for Deagle Arena. Open the panel, switch on what you want, and you can see every opponent through the map.

FEATURES
Bot detection - this game fills your lobby with bots that carry real usernames and real avatars, and nothing on screen tells you. Every one of them is marked [BOT]
ESP - box, name, level or elo, distance, kill streak, head marker and skeleton
Spawn protection marker - shooting a protected player only costs you your own 1.1 second cooldown
Real hitboxes - draws the actual BodyHitbox and HeadHitbox, both far larger than the model
Cooldown bar - a hit costs 0.9s and a miss 1.1s, and the game never shows you that number
Aim assist - camera only, separate horizontal and vertical smoothing, framerate independent, aimed at the body because damage is a flat 100 either way
Triggerbot - reads the gun's own cooldown so it never clicks into a reload
Silent aim - optional, with its own FOV circle, off by default
Chams in seven styles, custom colours for bots and real players
Humanisation - turn rate cap, reaction spread, wind up, break off, aim drift, dead zone
Round panel - who is alive, who is a bot, your elo, rank and streak

Works on mobile executors. The panel asks PC or phone on first run and scales itself, in four languages.

HOW TO RUN
1. Copy the script, execute it, press RightShift for the panel
2. Only the ESP is on by default

No key, no ads, and it never spends Robux.
Open source: https://github.com/seltonmt012/sel01-rbx/blob/main/games/deaglearena.lua
